outcome: rate of invasive procedure (conservative surgery, radiological embolization and/or hysterectomy)
cohort: 279 women with post-partum hemorrhage requiring potent uterotonic treatment with prostaglandins after cesarean delivery
finding: Implementation of intra-uterine tamponade balloon during post-partum hemorrhage after cesarean delivery appears to be safe and effective, with a decrease in both invasive procedures and transfusion rates.
mod_finding: This study investigated the use of an intra-uterine tamponade balloon during post-partum hemorrhage in a cesarean delivery setting.
